id: title:Gilbert09:retry compact table on delta commit conflicts

review.posthog_relevance: This chunk does not contain PostHog-specific code. The supplied observations describe changes to a Delta Lake conflict checker and retry helper, which are not part of the PostHog codebase. No PostHog user, reliability, or operational mechanism is demonstrated.
review.reason: The observed changes are strictly maintenance and refactoring: P1.F1.H1 is a comment update, P1.F1.H2 and P1.F1.H3 rename a helper and its call site while preserving identical behavior. This represents a bounded, localised implementation improvement. However, the code does not demonstrate a broader systemic capability or PostHog-specific benefit, and the observations explicitly do.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the nature of the implementation (bounded refactoring) rather than demonstrated PostHog value, as the relevant PostHog context is absent. No unverified outcomes are inferred.
